citations.narrative:
The facility's contingency plan's last documented review was for the school year of 2015-2016. A facility representative
described that the plan has been informally reviewed since then with discussions, however documented reviews have not
been completed. Regular annual documented reviews of the contingency plan helps ensure that the facility has plans in
place to care for animals during emergencies. The written contingency plan must be reviewed by the research facility on
at least an annual basis to ensure that it adequately addresses the criteria listed in Animal Welfare Act section 2.38(l)(1).
Each registrant must maintain documentation of their annual reviews, including documenting any amendments or
changes made to their plan since the previous year's review, such as changes made as a result of recently predicted, but
historically unforeseen, circumstances (e.g., weather extremes).
***Correct by November 30, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
